implementation.orchestrationRule: Stage is STAGED_UNQUALIFIED. Archive requires final payload-bound target signing, OS sandbox, lifecycle and desktop-release runtime receipts. No compile, fetch, signing, runtime, install or publication command is executed. Artifact refs and payload directories resolve relative to their containing JSON.

declaredInputAdapter.target: Exactly one declared target below; no host-based inference or architecture substitution

release.commit: Actual clean frozen full 40-hex Git commit, not a tree or shortened commit
release.tree: Actual full 40-hex Git tree for that commit
release.freezeReceipt: Artifact reference: relative path, exact byte count and SHA256; binds the source/version/channel and accepted component inputs

declaredInputAdapter.artifactReference: Object {path,sha256,bytes}. Relative paths and component payload.directory resolve relative to the JSON which contains them; payload.archive is a bound archive ref, with optional safe payload.root. New output paths must be absolute.

shell.version: Exactly 0.12.0, including the actual packaged app package.json version
shell.files: Exact relative source/dependency member map to bytes and SHA256; includes main, preload, service adapter, startup resources and every enabled Browser module
shell.dependencies: Frozen production dependency closure and notices; ws exactly8.22.0 when direct Browser is enabled. No development tools/test files/node_modules wildcard.
shell.qualificationReceipt: Source-qualified shell and lifecycle/IPC/input-policy receipt references, without implying actual platform runtime acceptance

electron.target: linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64 or windows-x64, matching the requested target
electron.archive: Exact verified upstream distribution artifact reference
electron.inventory: Exact regular/symlink member inventory, sizes, hashes and executable modes; preserve and validate required macOS framework links, reject escaping links and all Windows reparse indirection
electron.notices: Exact upstream license and Chromium third-party notice member references; all supplied required notices must be included and hashed in the final package

service.version: Actual compiled stable0.12.0; no relabeling a dev service, Linux binary, old native app or historical C emission
service.artifact: Genuine service payload artifact reference plus immutable source/emission/native-build receipts
service.compileConfiguration: Actual immutable release channel/version and Google/telemetry bake-required/present booleans only; no credential values or credential hashes
service.runtimeClosure: Target-owner measured mandatory service/helper/tool/runtime inventory and dependency edges, with exact package/version/architecture/hash/notices/source disposition. External optional provider/CAD dependencies remain explicitly optional.
service.qualificationReceipts: Target-scoped genuine-service/auth/ownership/shutdown/runtime acceptance references; missing evidence is pending and never inherited from another target

web.manifest: Exact matching generated/postprocessed web member map to bytes and SHA256, including index.html and every shipped asset and gzip sibling
web.gzip: Each shipped gzip decompresses exactly to its declared plain sibling; reject missing, extra, stale or case-colliding members
web.excluded: Machine fonts/font caches, user homes/profiles, credentials, experiments, old native UI and stale generated chunks

platformPolicy.signing: Explicit target policy plus actual signed/unsigned/not-applicable status, verification evidence and certificate identity when applicable; never infer signing from assembly
platformPolicy.sandbox: Actual target OS sandbox acceptance receipt and shipped flags/permissions; producer must not inject --no-sandbox. ContextIsolation true, sandbox true and nodeIntegration false remain source requirements, not OS acceptance evidence.
platformPolicy.launchAndOwnership: Target-supported home/startup/auth/readiness/single-instance/reconnect and normal close preserves resident service. Explicit frozen resident policy may keep managed stop/update unsupported; no POSIX/Cygwin lock-PID signalling.

darwin-arm64.bundleIdentity: Frozen explicit bundle ID/Info.plist/version fields, framework/helper layout and signatures supplied and qualified for this target

windowsService.input: The same SERVICE.json component as every other target (scripts/service-release.py component): {receipt, payload:{directory}}, pinned by freeze.components[target].serviceReceiptSha256
windowsService.service: backplane-serve.exe, a Bun-compiled PE32+ x64 (roles.service); its original BUILD.json records serviceRuntime 'bun' and service 'backplane-serve.exe'
windowsService.validate: As other targets: genuine configured BUILD, members, PE architecture, measured runtime closure (normal and delay PE imports, Windows system DLLs as approved-system), notices and matching web
windowsService.managedControl: The JS service has no Windows managed-control protocol. Windows ships only under root freeze.lifecyclePolicy[target] {mode:resident-service,managedStop:false,managedUpdate:false}, with shell windowsManagedControl 'UNSUPPORTED' and windowsNativePathMapping true; any other Windows policy is refused. No fake managed-stop PASS or lock-PID kill.

finalReceipt.file: DESKTOP.json at the declared archive root

requiredFields.release: Exact frozen commit/tree/version/tag/channel and freezeReceipt reference
requiredFields.entrypoint: Declared launcher path and backend entry src/server/main.bend; distinct roles
requiredFields.components: Separate shell, Electron runtime, service, web and dependency artifacts, each with exact source identity/version/hash and immutable receipt references; stable release requires the common freeze, not dev companion relabeling
requiredFields.noticesManifestSha256: Exact NOTICES.json hash binding included Electron/Chromium/ws/service/runtime notices and required source disposition
requiredFields.signing: Actual target result and verification receipt, or explicit unqualified status; no default true
requiredFields.sandbox: Actual target flags, permissions and platform acceptance receipt, or explicit pending status
requiredFields.lifecycle: Actual target native service ownership/path/auth/readiness/shutdown receipt, or explicit pending status
requiredFields.runtimeAcceptance: Target-owner result/receipt hashes and scope; assembly alone never PASS
requiredFields.members: Exact archive-relative regular files with SHA256/bytes/mode and safe link target records; excludes DESKTOP.json and MANIFEST.json to avoid receipt self-hash cycles

finalReceipt.outerManifest: MANIFEST.json binds all payload members plus DESKTOP.json and NOTICES.json; excludes itself. External archive SHA256 binds MANIFEST.json and all archive bytes. Archive timestamps/order/modes and link handling must be deterministic.
finalReceipt.receiptExposure: Release job exposes archive, digest, DESKTOP.json, MANIFEST.json and NOTICES.json under explicit artifact IDs; exact inner/outer equality checked by aggregate owner. No signature or cross-target acceptance inferred from upload success.

implementationGaps: Actual clean stable 0.12.0 common source freeze and genuine configured per-target artifacts remain external inputs; existing dev runtime evidence is not stable evidence.
All actual target lifecycle/sandbox/signing/runtime receipts remain required; offline synthetic checks do not qualify a platform.
AppImage, DMG, installers and updater feeds are not outputs. Native mobile producers remain owned separately.

Actual Windows startup/path/auth/reconnect/close-persistence and OS sandbox/runtime qualification remain required. Windows ships only under the explicit resident-service policy: the JS service has no Windows managed stop/update.
scope: Callable source implementation plus synthetic offline checks only. No actual platform production build, service/web emission, signing, runtime qualification, CI, install, tag or publication by this implementation handoff.

supersedes.reason: User changed actual GitHub stable release target to0.12.0; old contract preserved byteexact.

publication.persistence: Continue authorized work through root publication; do not treat a plan, source-only contract, partial stage or artifact upload as release completion

residentServicePolicy.serviceUpdater: Owned packaged resident launch sets BACKPLANE_NO_UPDATE=1; no stop/update IPC added
residentServicePolicy.commercialSigning: Explicit root unsigned-portable-allowed is supported; actual OS sandbox and target smoke are still required.
